card.name: Right before the word drug appears
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'drug' or 'pharmacologic' word, such as 'non' in 'non-pharmacologic' or 'DR' in capitalized 'DRUGS'. It also fires on 'multiple-dr' before 'ug'.

modes.label: non before pharmacologic
modes.description: The word 'non' after 'alternative medications and', leading into 'non-pharmacologic treatments'.

modes.label: Start of DRUGS in capitals
modes.description: The 'DR' piece at the start of 'DRUGS' in all-caps warning headings.

modes.label: Other drug-word openings
modes.description: Partial words leading into 'drugs', such as 'PROLONGING' before 'DRUGS' or 'multiple-dr' before 'ug'.

card.writes: It suppresses 'drug' and 'medication' words in English and Chinese, so it acts as a brake on the model repeating a drug term right after the marked word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'drug' or 'pharmacologic' in a phrase, as in 'non-pharmacologic' or 'other DRUGS'.
